purpose: re-run the kept/revised/dead_end labelling with the cross-scaffold code path on the SWE-agent corpus, to prove the port is faithful and to fix the reference against which the other scaffolds are compared

frozen_headline.scope: every edit step of every run, including runs that produced no patch at all (13.99% of the edits)

reference_nonempty_patch_runs_only.scope: strictly comparable with scaffolds whose final patch has to be recovered from the transcript, where a run with no patch cannot be distinguished from a run with an empty patch
